                 Table "public.rooms"
  Column  |   Type    | Collation | Nullable | Default 
----------+-----------+-----------+----------+---------
 id       | integer   |           | not null | 
 valid_at | daterange |           | not null | 
Indexes:
    "rooms_pk" PRIMARY KEY (id, valid_at WITHOUT OVERLAPS)
Referenced by:
    TABLE "room_names" CONSTRAINT "room_names_fk" FOREIGN KEY (id, PERIOD valid_at) REFERENCES rooms(id, PERIOD valid_at)
